title: Luminous polystyrene upconverted nanoparticles to visualize the traces of nanoplastics in a vegetable plant
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1273-1287
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01052C, Paper
Bushra Maryam, Muhammad Asim, Jiaxuan Li, Hamna Qayyum, Xianhua Liu
This study introduces a novel method for visualizing the uptake and accumulation of polystyrene nanoplastics in edible plants using luminous upconverted nanoparticles.
